sections.title: Personal income tax (φόρος εισοδήματος) from tax year 2026

source.title: Tax Department: Declaration for claiming tax deductions for the tax year 2026 (Form T.D.59A, English), Part C Tax computation

sections.basis: Annual taxable income (calendar tax year), after exemptions and deductions
sections.note: The 2026 tax reform (Law 244(I)/2025) raised the tax-free amount from €19,500 to €22,000 and widened the bands; the top rate of 35% now starts above €72,000. Employers withhold the tax monthly (PAYE) using the deductions the employee declares on form T.D.59. Self-employed profits are taxed on the same scale.

sections.basis: Deducted from taxable income, euro per tax year
sections.note: Only Cyprus tax residents get the new deductions; they are subject to the income limits below (except home insurance) and are not transferable between spouses. A dependent child is under 18, a secondary school pupil under 20, in the National Guard under 21, a full-time student up to 24, or permanently unable to support themselves (status at 31 December).
